# ABI checks remain enabled, without nolivein. The native packet draw member reads
# packet and drawing context; other incoming registers remain caller-clobbered CPU state.
# Heap callbacks are abstract mocks, with a known three-register allocation signature
# and a free target; no independent heap implementation verification is claimed.
# Native immutable two-entry PTMF table is tested at modes0/1. Counts0..3 use bounded
# buckets and null-terminated one/two-packet lists. remove excludes head.next==target
# when head!=target because that native branch never terminates.
